purpose: Teach: 縮減/教示/貸し付け/取り付ける/通帳/差し止め/持ち株/引き下げる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費の縮減方策を考えろ
lines.en: Ren, I need you to develop a cost-reduction strategy for the research budget.
lines.style: Direct but not cold. Clear instruction from someone accustomed to being heard. Slight pause before the task itself, like settling in. Expects compliance, not negotiation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新人にデータ整理をご教示しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently having the new staff member organize and file the data.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive posture in the voice. Eager to show progress but not overstating. Steady pace. The answer of someone who anticipated this might come up.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究機材の貸し付け制度を活用しろ
lines.en: Ren, make sure you're utilizing the equipment-loan system for the research materials.
lines.style: Instructive, matter-of-fact. The second directive—slightly more specific. Same authority as before but now offering a concrete tool. Brief, efficient.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験装置を新たに取り付ける手配をしました
lines.en: Yes. I've already arranged for the new experimental apparatus to be installed.
lines.style: Quick, assured response. Shows initiative without boasting. The tone of someone who was already thinking ahead. Small uptick of quiet satisfaction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費の通帳管理を厳格にしろ
lines.en: Ren, tighten up the accounting practices on the research fund ledgers.
lines.style: Third instruction, firmest of the three. Not harsh—exacting. A note of emphasis on the word 'strict.' The tone of someone who has seen problems before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の差し止め命令にも対応します
lines.en: Yes. I'm also prepared to handle any publication holds or restrictions that come through.
lines.style: Dutiful, almost protective in scope. Shows he understands the wider implications. The confidence of someone who is thinking several steps ahead. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の持ち株的な役割分担を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren, confirm the role distribution and shared-responsibility structure on the collaborative research project.
lines.style: The final directive—more complex, layered. Slow enough to land clearly. The tone of someone testing whether Ren is tracking the bigger picture, not just the immediate task.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。試薬の単価を引き下げる交渉に努力します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also put effort into negotiating lower per-unit costs on the reagent supplies.
lines.style: Definitive closing statement. The upward lift shows commitment. Demonstrates not just compliance but independent problem-solving. Last response carries weight and finality.
